summary.bottom_line: Unit tests catch regressions cheaply when they isolate pure logic from I/O.
key_points: Pure functions are the cheapest code to test and the first to extract
Integration tests cover the seams between modules, not the modules themselves
End-to-end tests are reserved for the three critical user journeys
summary.whats_new: Argues that most suites over-invest in end-to-end coverage and under-invest in extraction.
summary.caveats: Based on the author's experience at two companies; no measurements are given.
summary.read_in_full_if: You maintain a slow end-to-end suite and want a migration plan.

arguments_for: Unit tests give the fastest feedback per dollar
arguments_against: End-to-end suites are slow and flaky
